slot.brief: Vector triple product expression a × (b × c) with given simple vectors; use the standard expansion and compute the result vector.

stem: Given $\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k$, $\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k$ and $\vec c=3\hat i+2\hat k$, find $\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)$.

verdicts.working: \(\vec b\times\vec c=(4,-5,-6)\), so \(\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=(21,24,-6)\).

working:
$\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\vec b(\vec a\cdot\vec c)-\vec c(\vec a\cdot\vec b)$
$\vec a\cdot\vec c=12,\quad \vec a\cdot\vec b=-3$
$=12(\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k)+3(3\hat i+2\hat k)=21\hat i+24\hat j-6\hat k$

Independent check: \(\vec b\times\vec c=(4,-5,-6)\), so \(\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=(21,24,-6)\).
solution:
Using $
\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\vec b(\vec a\cdot\vec c)-\vec c(\vec a\cdot\vec b),
\quad \vec a\cdot\vec c=12,\quad \vec a\cdot\vec b=-3.$
$$\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=12(\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k)+3(3\hat i+2\hat k)=21\hat i+24\hat j-6\hat k.$$
